descriptions.d28d_worm_ground_probe_8014f18c: Worm ground probe: starts a nearest-hit query from the position raised by 10 along the given direction; on no hit or too many hits returns 0. A hit inside the start point takes the surface normal and tests the slide direction against it; otherwise moves the worm to the hit point, stores the normal, sets the grounded flag and refreshes slope state, with state 9 on steep ground. Returns 1 when the worm stays grounded.
